item.text:
In **ResStock 2025 Release 1**, advanced air sealing:

- **Applies to homes with baseline leakage of ≥6 ACH50.** Homes below 6 ACH50 are excluded.
- **Seals eligible homes to 5 ACH50.** Both the cutoff and target are specified in the [release’s upgrade configuration](https://github.com/NatLabRockies/resstock/blob/2025_Release_1/project_national/sdr_upgrades_tmy3.yml#L186-L200).
- **Applies to about 92% of existing dwelling units**, according to the [release measure documentation, p. 1](https://docs.nlr.gov/docs/fy26osti/96281.pdf#page=9).

ACH50 means air changes per hour measured at a pressure difference of 50 pascals.
